safety_notice: This does not replace calling your local emergency number directly. A connection cannot be guaranteed (no signal, no credit, no internet, network outages).
verification_rule: A number is verified=true only when it appears in the ITU-T E.129 entry that the country's own administration reported to ITU (for territories inside a parent numbering plan, the parent's entry), or, for 112 in EU Member States, Directive (EU) 2018/1972 art. 109. A country is verified=true only when every number shown for it is verified. Everything else is 'unverified': the page shows it with a warning plus 112 as a mobile-phone fallback. ITU entries carry their own last-update date; several are from 2012, so 'verified' means 'matches the official list on file', not 'tested by dialling'.

itu_e129.title: ITU-T E.129 database: National-only numbers linked with emergency services and other services of social value (data reported by Member States per Rec. ITU-T E.129 (01/2013))
itu_e129.note: Amendments are published in the ITU Operational Bulletin. Refresh with `python emergency_comms.py fetch-itu rows.json` then `reconcile-itu rows.json`.
